title: Shakira - Waka Waka *STEP BY STEP TUTORIAL* (Beginner Friendly)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher uses a casual, encouraging tone and breaks down complex movements into simple, manageable steps. He frequently uses analogies and body-language cues to help students understand the rhythm and feel of the dance.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the first step, emphasizing the need to get up from a sleep position.
The teacher breaks down the first step, explaining the arm and body movements.
The teacher demonstrates the first step in slow motion, focusing on the punch and tap.
The teacher introduces the jump and hand movement, connecting it to the previous step.
The teacher practices the jump and hand movement at a slower speed.
The teacher explains the hip movement and the 'aerobic dance' style.
The teacher introduces the swimming arm movement and the weight transfer.
The teacher explains the box-pulling movement and the importance of pelvis movement.
The teacher introduces the drop and toe-stand movement.
The teacher practices the sequence at 50% speed with music.
The teacher reviews the lyrics and the corresponding dance steps.

steps_taught.name: Getting up from sleep
steps_taught.description: Start with right hand up, left hand out, and pretend to wake up.

steps_taught.name: Jump and hand pull
steps_taught.description: Jump with hands up and pull them down.

steps_taught.name: Aerobic dance
steps_taught.description: Move hips side to side with optional hand shaking.

steps_taught.name: Box pull
steps_taught.description: Switch body weight and pull an imaginary box to yourself.

steps_taught.name: Drop and toe stand
steps_taught.description: Drop on the right leg and stand on your toes.

what_hinders: the teacher sometimes goes a bit fast
the mirrored video can be confusing for some
